headline: Clinton order directs federal support for local community efforts along rivers designated as American Heritage Rivers.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order sets up a way for the federal government to support community efforts along certain rivers called American Heritage Rivers. No summary was provided, so the details are unclear, such as how rivers are chosen, what kind of help agencies give, and whether any money or new rules are involved.

who_it_affects.group: Communities located along designated American Heritage Rivers
who_it_affects.how: They may receive federal support for their local river-related efforts.
They are likely directed to support these community efforts, though the specific duties are not described in the provided material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 11, 1997; no separate effective date was provided.
